_about: Ribbon shader presets — the single source the Ribbon Shader Studio, www.exaforce.com and the tools site read. Colour ramps are brand data tuned by eye in the studio; forms are shader tunings. Hex values on purpose: they are fed to a GPU as linear-light uniforms, not to CSS, so they do not map onto the design tokens. Retune in the studio (ribbon-shader-studio.html), paste the result here, bump the version.

colours.name: brand-light
colours.about: Pale brand tints on a near-white ground. Quiet enough to sit behind copy or a screenshot.

colours.name: brand-medium
colours.about: Full-strength brand colours on a lilac-to-peach ground. The most saturated of the three. Ground stops run bottom-first.

colours.name: brand-dark
colours.about: Brand hues as glowing strands over near-black indigo. Additive light, so it has no transparent export. Ground stops run bottom-first; strand is [halo tint, hot core].

forms.name: thin
forms.about: A narrow taut band that reads as a line rather than a mass.

forms.name: medium
forms.about: Balanced width and strand count. The general-purpose starting point.

forms.name: thick
forms.about: A broad soft sweep filling the frame, with striation dialled back to a wash.

forms.name: crisp
forms.about: Narrow band, full striation, hard edge. Strands resolve individually.
